event.unit: one accepted observation and its one free greedy act; a lesson at that event belongs to the same event
event.clock: the declared slot schedule supplies physical time only; no clock value, slot number or phase enters any observation

observations.drive: coordinate 0 at 1.0 on every drive and cue event
observations.cue: one cue coordinate at 1.0 on the first event of a bout, two rows per cue

teaching.label: the cued action at a cue event; afterwards the opposite of the row's own last executed action

arms.every: Learner.step on the live stimulus before every free act
arms.mismatch: free act first; Learner.step on the pre-act stimulus for the rows whose act differed from the label

window.probe: complete checkpoint after the lead act and before the next act; every control forks it

disturbances.pause_checkpoint: pause2 saves after its first pause event; a loaded twin continues beside the original

cadence.host_load: one spinning process per logical CPU during the paced_regular_load run

recipes.note: rhythm/2 declares one candidate gene against the rhythm/1 selected recipe as its control: efference changes nothing but the efference copy, Brain.compose(..., efference_amplitude=3.0, efference_decay=0.0), one efference neuron per motor neuron driven by the one-hot of the command the row issued at the previous event and read by the association region through a plastic projection at the working trace's scale; the working trace, learning law, lateral wiring and every other setting are those of rhythm/1 selected. selected is the rhythm/1 selected recipe, byte-identical, run on every founder as the control; the rhythm/1 compose_default control and its receipt stand as published.
recipes.development: chosen on development seeds 0-5 at 24 bouts over efference amplitudes 0.3/1.0/3.0 and efference decays 0.0/0.2/0.5 beside the amplitude-0 control, every failed cell kept in results/development-efference.json; mean window alternation over both arms: control 0.73, amplitude 3.0 at decay 0.0 0.97 (every 1.00 on all six seeds, mismatch 0.93); confirmation seeds 201-205 are fresh and were not run during development

policy.refusal: a refused act is a missed action: no action, no trace update, the event is consumed, the life continues
policy.lesson_refusal: a refused lesson is charged and skipped
policy.forks: controls load the probe checkpoint; no fork installs state into the live life
policy.denominator: every planned founder stays in the denominator; refused and unrun events are wrong
policy.selection: the efference copy is the one declared mechanism; it is selected on the development seeds only and confirmed on fresh seeds; no default change, acceptance horizon beyond the declared window or general timing capability is claimed

caps.note: a run past the cap writes its completed founders and exits 3

question: Can one continuing Brain.compose life whose working trace alone did not carry the phase (rhythm/1) alternate two actions under identical drive once it carries a copy of its own last command, against the same brain without the copy, the matched flip-flop control and uniform random? The efference copy is the declared mechanism under test; it is a gene with zero as its control, not a default.
phase_state: the row's working trace (Trace.trace, Trace.last, Trace.cold over the 32 association coordinates) and, under the efference recipe, its efference copy (Efference.trace, .last, .cold over the 2 motor coordinates, the one-hot of the row's last issued action at decay 0); the erased, shuffled, static and reset controls act on the whole carried history, trace and copy
